name: Sun Cleric: Valkyr's Calling's charge-back damage lands on its cast target whatever the player has selected
contract: Valkyr's Calling 520024 reads 'Target an enemy and leap into the air ... At the end of the duration, you charge
back down, dealing ... Holy damage to all enemies within $570034a1 yds.' Owner ruling O-32: the charge-back lands
on the stored original victim whatever the player's selection. The landing spell 570034 has EffectImplicitTargetA[0]
53 TARGET_DEST_TARGET_ENEMY and TargetB 16 TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY (8 yd): it needs a unit target and centres
its area on it. The landing cast passed only a position, so Spell::InitExplicitTargets took the player's selection:
no selection or a friendly one refused 570034 (cast_failure 27) and another enemy selected moved the area onto that
enemy. The landing now casts 570034 at the victim stored at the cast. Four level-60 Sun Clerics each cast 520024 at
their own dummy 3 yd away: one with no selection, one with itself selected (friendly), one with a second hostile
dummy 20 yd away selected (17 yd from the victim, outside the 8 yd area) and the control with the victim selected,
which landed before the change. Each 520024 cast must be accepted; 5000 ms after it (2000 ms flight, then the
charge) the victim has taken 570034 damage from its caster, 570034 has no refusal and the decoy has taken none

steps.label: Let login hooks and spawn AI settle
SETUP: the cast with no selection is accepted
SETUP: the cast with a friendly selection is accepted
SETUP: the cast with the decoy selected is accepted
SETUP: the control cast is accepted
Let the 2000 ms flight end and the charge land
CONTROL: with the victim selected the charge-back damages the victim
DISCRIMINATING: with no selection the landing spell is not refused
DISCRIMINATING: with no selection the charge-back damages the victim
DISCRIMINATING: with a friendly selection the landing spell is not refused
DISCRIMINATING: with a friendly selection the charge-back damages the victim
DISCRIMINATING: with another enemy selected the charge-back damages the victim
DISCRIMINATING: the selected enemy 17 yd from the victim takes no charge-back damage
